items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: I used to be co-writer. ... It was Fess's original thing. I didn't create it as such. But I helped make that record.

ctx.x: And I helped organize it into a beginning, middle, and end, and like that. Contributed. Cleaned up. Clarified some of the words. You don't clarify much with Fess, but clarified some of the words. Mm-hmm. And gave it some structure. It was Fess's original thing. I didn't create it as such. But I helped make that record.
Mm-hmm. Do you have a credit on there? Do you have a? I used to be co-writer.
